changeSet.author: abhijith
changeSet.comment:
Leave request numbers move from leave_request_sequence to the shared document_number_sequence counter (#858). The counter for each organization and year starts at the higher of two values: the highest LR-YYYY-NNNNNN number already in leave_request, and the old counter. Restored data had left rows ahead of the old counter, and every create in such an organization proposed a number that was taken.
The allocator also reads the highest number in use on every create, so this seed is what keeps the first number after the upgrade in sequence rather than what makes it unique. Re-runnable: ON CONFLICT keeps whichever value is higher.
LR- is three characters, so the year sits at offset 4 and the sequence at offset 9, the same positions as PO- in changeset 061.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO document_number_sequence (organization_id, document_type, sequence_year, last_allocated, created_at, updated_at) SELECT organization_id, 'LEAVE_REQUEST', CAST(substring(request_number, 4, 4) AS INT), MAX(CAST(substring(request_number, 9) AS INT8)), current_timestamp, current_timestamp FROM leave_request WHERE organization_id IS NOT NULL AND request_number ~ '^LR-[0-9]{4}-[0-9]+$' GROUP BY organization_id, CAST(substring(request_number, 4, 4) AS INT) ON CONFLICT (organization_id, document_type, sequence_year) DO UPDATE SET last_allocated = greatest(document_number_sequence.last_allocated, excluded.last_allocated);

INSERT INTO document_number_sequence (organization_id, document_type, sequence_year, last_allocated, created_at, updated_at) SELECT organization_id, 'LEAVE_REQUEST', "year", last_sequence, current_timestamp, current_timestamp FROM leave_request_sequence WHERE last_sequence > 0 ON CONFLICT (organization_id, document_type, sequence_year) DO UPDATE SET last_allocated = greatest(document_number_sequence.last_allocated, excluded.last_allocated);

changeSet.author: abhijith
changeSet.comment: The request number is unique within an organization, like every other document number since changeset 061. Added before the global constraint is dropped, so the column is never unconstrained in between.

changeSet.author: abhijith
changeSet.comment: Removes the cross-tenant constraint. The column was declared unique inline in every baseline, which CockroachDB names leave_request_request_number_key and backs with an index of that name, so the index is what is dropped.

rollback.comment: A global constraint cannot be restored once two organizations share a number.
